name: Replay Tools
description: In-game menu (hotkey Y) for speed control, macro recording/playback and No Clip. Safe mode is on by default.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: When enabled, the level is marked as test mode while speed is changed, a macro is playing, or No Clip is on, so progress and completions are not saved or submitted. Can also be toggled from the mod menu.

menu-key.name: Menu key
menu-key.description: Letter or number that opens the mod menu inside a level (default: Y).

speed.name: Game speed
speed.description: 1.0 is normal. Any other value stops progress from being saved while safe mode is on. Easier to adjust from the in-game menu.

macro-file.name: Macro file to load
macro-file.description: Pick any macro file, then press 'From Settings' in the mod menu.
